lines.text: The Teacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem and set his mind to explore all that is done under heaven.
The Teacher found all things under the sun futile and said much wisdom brings much sorrow.
The Teacher tested himself with pleasure, called laughter folly, and sought to cheer his body with milk.
He built houses, planted vineyards, made gardens, gathered bronze and iron, and became greater than all before him.
He denied himself no pleasure, yet found everything futile, with nothing to be gained under the sun.
